output.summary: VERIFIED after 2 attempt(s): 8 order(s) reviewed, 24/24 evidence items verified against Zetaris. Needs human review: L102 (missing invoice candidate), L103 (unpaid replacement invoice), L105 (possible duplicate billing), L106 (cancelled without replacement), L107 (unpaid invoice), L108 (missing invoice candidate).

findings.explanation: Invoice I101 is issued and paid; no outstanding issues.
Completed lab order L102 has no invoice found in the data. This is a MISSING_INVOICE_CANDIDATE; the invoice may exist in another system or under a different order key.
findings.uncertainty: The invoice may exist in a system we cannot see, or under an order id that was keyed differently in billing. Confidence is medium because the absence of an invoice is unverified.
findings.recommended_action: Verify with billing team whether invoice exists under a different order key or system.

findings.explanation: Invoice I102 was cancelled as duplicate. History shows I104 replaced it; I104 is issued but not yet paid, so the order is billed once with a cancelled original and an unpaid replacement.
findings.uncertainty: A payment for I104 may exist that has not been recorded yet.
findings.recommended_action: Check payment status of I104 with the billing team.

findings.explanation: Invoice I103 is issued and paid; no outstanding issues.

Order L105 has two invoices (I105 and I106) both with issued status and paid payment status, but no history (event_type or notes) explains why two invoices exist or their relationship. Without supporting history, possible duplicate billing cannot be ruled out.
findings.uncertainty: No cancellation or replacement history found; the relationship between I105 and I106 is unconfirmed.
findings.recommended_action: Human review needed to determine if I105 and I106 represent duplicate billing or legitimate separate billing.

evidence.value: Cancelled after insurance change; no new invoice

findings.explanation: Invoice I107 was cancelled after an insurance change, and no replacement invoice was issued.
findings.recommended_action: No action required unless replacement is needed; flag for audit if pattern emerges.

findings.explanation: Invoice I108 was issued with payment status unpaid (note trailing space); no cancellation or replacement history. Requires payment follow-up.
findings.uncertainty: Payment for I108 may have been recorded but not updated; trailing space in payment_status indicates possible data inconsistency.
findings.recommended_action: Follow up on payment status of I108 with billing team.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.role: LangGraph state machine: runs attempts, routes critic feedback back to the investigator, stops at 3 attempts or the run's time budget

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Plans the data it needs, asks the Data Agent in plain language, writes evidence-backed findings under the reconciliation business rules

agents.name: Data Agent
agents.role: Turns requests into read-only SQL over the Zetaris USL table and returns the raw rows unchanged

agents.name: World Model (Meterless engine)
agents.role: Per-run register of every Zetaris row, derived link, finding and verdict, with provenance and an audit log

agents.name: Critic (code checks)
agents.role: Verifies every evidence item against the register; on failure sends concrete fixes back and skips the LLM critic

agents.name: Critic (LLM)
agents.role: Judges logic, candidate vs confirmed, replacement vs duplicate and coverage; ACCEPT or RETRY
